doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Returning, meeting Linda at Elario's in San Diego
summary: After a relationship in Canada ended he wanted to practice, then met Linda at a San Diego club and sent her roses weekly.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah, then I left 'cause I had a relationship up there and I -- I left there and came back and I didn't want to be bothered with anything. I said, "That's it! You know, no more. I just wanna practice and study." And then I got a -- a -- a gig coming to San Diego at a place called Elario's [phonetic sp.] and that's where I met my Honey. Yeah.

Yeah. I met Honey and -- and I had a 2-week engagement here. I didn't want to leave, but I was going on a tour of Africa with Dizzy. You know, so, I -- I didn't want her to forget me, so I sent her a dozen roses, had a dozen roses sent every Monday to her office, you know. And that was going on 5 years now.
And -- and she still gets 'em. You know? Yeah. Yeah. You know what I mean?
[indiscernible] That's funny 'cause she wasn't looking to get married or anything, either. You know?
So. You know. So, anyway, that's what I'm doing now is trying to get better, you
